svg.title: One result — different uses on screen and in follow-ups
svg.desc: A successful response supplies the screen with all loaded rows, while future AI questions receive recent context with all loaded rows per retained turn. The history budget removes whole turns, without sampling rows. Browser table actions and CSV use the loaded snapshot. A separate CSV API reruns SQL and may observe newer data. New chat or reload clears local conversation state.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
color: rgb(76, 29, 149) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 280px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(23, 32, 51) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 280px; text-align: center;

span.p: On screen: Keep all loaded rows

div.style: color: rgb(23, 32, 51) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 280px; text-align: center; width: 280px;

span.p: Sort, page, and resize: Use only the loaded rows

div.style: color: rgb(6, 78, 59) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 280px; text-align: center; width: 280px;

span.p: Download CSV: Same rows, original database order

div.style: color: rgb(76, 29, 149) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 280px; text-align: center; width: 280px;

span.p: For follow-up questions: All loaded rows per retained turn

div.style: color: rgb(120, 53, 15) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 280px; text-align: center; width: 280px;

span.p: History budget: Drop whole turns above 40 messages or 120,000 characters

div.style: color: rgb(23, 32, 51) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 280px; text-align: center; width: 280px;

span.p: Next question: Start a fresh request

div.style: color: rgb(120, 53, 15) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 280px; text-align: center; width: 280px;

span.p: New chat or reload: Clears local conversation state

div.style: color: rgb(120, 53, 15) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 280px; text-align: center; width: 280px;
